summary.zh: 选数据架构，评估数据资产与训练数据合规
summary.en: Pick data architecture, audit training data, value assets

description.zh: 处理数据战略决策：能否用客户数据训练模型、选数据仓库还是 lakehouse 或 data mesh、如何在融资或并购中给数据资产估值。适合制定数据战略或排定数据团队招聘顺序时使用。
description.en: Covers data strategy calls: training models on customer data, choosing warehouse, lakehouse or data mesh, and valuing data assets for a raise or M&A. Use it to set direction or sequence data hiring.
